evals.name: Dark Mode Default & Reactive Signal ThemeService
evals.prompt: Implement an Angular ThemeService initializing in Dark Mode by default with OS prefers-color-scheme detection, localStorage persistence, and root class toggling.
evals.expected_output: Creates a singleton ThemeService with isDarkMode signal defaulting to true (with OS fallback), syncing .dark-theme/.light-theme on the documentElement and storing preference in localStorage.
assertions: Initializes isDarkMode signal defaulting to true with OS preference fallback
Toggles .dark-theme and .light-theme on documentElement via Angular effect
Provides public toggleTheme() method updating reactive signal state

evals.name: Angular Material First Components & Accessible Theme Toggle
evals.prompt: Build an accessible standalone ThemeToggleComponent using MatIconButton, MatIcon, and MatTooltip that invokes ThemeService.
evals.expected_output: Creates a standalone component with OnPush change detection, aria-label, MatTooltip, MatIcon switching between dark_mode and light_mode.
assertions: Uses mat-icon-button with dynamic light_mode and dark_mode icons
Provides accessible aria-label and matTooltip reflecting current theme state
Prioritizes Angular Material component imports over raw HTML elements

evals.name: Zero-FOUC Script & Automated Material Audit
evals.prompt: Audit an Angular codebase using audit_angular_material.py to detect raw HTML form controls, hardcoded hex colors, and verify zero-FOUC script presence.
evals.expected_output: Executes scripts/audit_angular_material.py against target project, verifying presence of zero-FOUC head script, ThemeService, and flagging raw HTML buttons or inputs.
assertions: Verifies presence of zero-FOUC synchronous script in index.html
Detects raw HTML button and input elements lacking Material directives
Outputs structured compliance report with pass/fail checkpoints
